question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Encircle
solution:
The correct answer is "**Exclude**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word "encircle" means to surround or form a circle around something.**(घेरना)

 
 
• Example: The police encircled the building to catch the suspect.
 
 
 
 
 
• The antonym of "encircle" is **"exclude," which means to leave something or someone out or to prevent them from entering or being included.**(निकालना)
 
 
• ​ Example: The invitation excluded certain guests from the party.
 
 
 
• Grammatically, "encircle" is a verb while "exclude" is also a verb, but with a different meaning.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Entire means whole or complete, which is not an antonym of "encircle."(पूरा)
 
• - Option 2: Entice means to attract or persuade someone to do something, which is not an antonym of "encircle."(लुभाने)
 
• - Option 3: Embrace means to hold someone or something closely, which is not an antonym of "encircle."(अपनाना)
